cohort: 1055 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born alive and admitted to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at King Abdulaziz Medical City-Jeddah (KAMC-Jeddah) between January 1, 1994, and December 31, 2019
finding: Cesarean birth is associated with higher survival for VLBW infants with birth weight ≤800 g and extremely low birth weight infants and gestational age ≤26 weeks compared to vaginal birth.
